items.symptom: Node default lookup: Cannot find module playwright
items.cause: Playwright is installed under the existing local evidence tool directory, outside default Node module lookup.
items.verification: Six real Chromium/ttyd/tmux screenshots completed with exit code 0.

items.symptom: Guest had neither podman nor skopeo for importing the dedicated OCI image.
items.cause: The existing Kubernetes installation included CRI-O but no separate OCI image import CLI.
items.resolution: Installed podman with apt --no-install-recommends; imported OCI into the Guest root containers storage. No Kubernetes or VM restart.
items.verification: Pod used the exact imported digest with imagePullPolicy Never; Kubernetes event reports image already present.
items.nonfatal_install_warnings: Headless SSH produced debconf Dialog/Readline fallback and stdin warnings. apt completed with exit 0; Podman import and actual Pod execution succeeded. These are retained in the installation transcript.

items.symptom: sudo: crictl: command not found during initial image tool discovery.
items.cause: crictl was not installed in this VM.
items.resolution: Used kubectl resource JSON for runtime status and podman for OCI image import/inspection; no dependency on crictl remains.
items.verification: Final Pod imageID and podman inspection agree.

items.symptom: -Wmisleading-indentation at first-kernel event followed by iterations++.
items.cause: Two statements on the same line after an unbraced if.
items.resolution: Added braces and moved increment to a separate line.
items.verification: Compiled with -Wall -Wextra -Werror successfully before image import and GPU execution.

items.symptom: Two NotFound responses when the monitor queried the Pod before creation.
items.cause: The observer intentionally starts before Pod creation, but its initial query did not use --ignore-not-found.
items.resolution: Preserved both original responses; updated optional monitor queries to --ignore-not-found and treat empty output as waiting for creation.
items.verification: Querying the now-deleted experimental Pod returns exit code 0 and empty output. No extra GPU run was needed.

items.symptom: Initial verifier rejected the second NotFound observation.
items.cause: It compared observation start to create command start; one GET overlapped the create request and returned NotFound before the create response completed.
items.resolution: Compare completed NotFound observations to successful create completion, retaining all original timestamps and outputs.
items.verification: Offline verifier passes with both original observations retained; no GPU rerun or source evidence rewrite.

items.symptom: git diff --check flagged apt CRLF/trailing spaces and terminal blank lines.
items.cause: Original captured terminal output naturally contains these bytes; source-format checks treated it as edited source text.
items.resolution: Added narrowly scoped -whitespace attributes for the captured apt transcript and terminal screen dumps. Existing -text prevents EOL normalization. Did not trim or rewrite raw evidence.
items.verification: Staged diff check passes and SHA256SUMS validates the retained original files.
